name: mm-crypto-bot
description: Bun + Turborepo + TS ultra-strict monorepo scaffold az mm-crypto-bot projekthez

scripts.lint: eslint --config eslint.config.js apps packages scripts search-best-config eslint.config.js --max-warnings=0
scripts.lint:hook: bun --eval 'const { createBunGitCommandRunner, createBunProcessCommandRunner, runStagedFileValidation } = await import("./scripts/tooling/staged-file-validation.ts"); await runStagedFileValidation("lint", { runGit: createBunGitCommandRunner(Bun.spawn), runProcess: createBunProcessCommandRunner(Bun.spawn) });'
scripts.format:hook: bun --eval 'const { createBunGitCommandRunner, createBunProcessCommandRunner, runStagedFileValidation } = await import("./scripts/tooling/staged-file-validation.ts"); await runStagedFileValidation("format", { runGit: createBunGitCommandRunner(Bun.spawn), runProcess: createBunProcessCommandRunner(Bun.spawn) });'
scripts.clean:artifacts: bun --eval 'const { cleanArtifacts } = await import("./scripts/tooling/clean-artifacts.ts"); await cleanArtifacts({ expectedRepositoryRoot: process.cwd(), log: (message) => process.stdout.write(`${message}\n`), mode: "inspect", rootDirectory: process.cwd() });'
scripts.clean:artifacts:dry-run: bun --eval 'const { cleanArtifacts } = await import("./scripts/tooling/clean-artifacts.ts"); await cleanArtifacts({ expectedRepositoryRoot: process.cwd(), log: (message) => process.stdout.write(`${message}\n`), mode: "inspect", rootDirectory: process.cwd() });'
scripts.clean:artifacts:trusted: bun --eval 'const { cleanArtifacts } = await import("./scripts/tooling/clean-artifacts.ts"); await cleanArtifacts({ expectedRepositoryRoot: process.cwd(), log: (message) => process.stdout.write(`${message}\n`), mode: "trusted-cleanup", rootDirectory: process.cwd() });'
scripts.coverage:bot:e2e-preload: sh -c 'unset NODE npm_node_execpath npm_execpath; PATH="${PATH#/tmp/bun-node-*:}"; exec node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config scripts/coverage-tools/vitest.bot-e2e-preload.config.mjs --coverage'
scripts.coverage:merge: bun scripts/lcov-tools.mjs merge coverage/merged/lcov.info apps/bot/coverage/unit/lcov.info packages/paper/coverage/lcov.info packages/exchange/coverage/lcov.info packages/core/coverage/lcov.info packages/shared/coverage/lcov.info packages/backtest/coverage/lcov.info packages/backtest-tools/coverage/lcov.info packages/logging/coverage/unit/lcov.info packages/typing/coverage/lcov.info packages/typeguard/coverage/lcov.info packages/assert/coverage/lcov.info packages/numeric/coverage/lcov.info
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && rm -rf node_modules .turbo coverage
